items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was playing piano, with Lawrence Brown, Johnny Hodges, Al Hall the bass player, Denzil Best the drummer, and Billy Strayhorn was playing congas.

ctx.x: I was just about to ask you what would Ellington's music do to your nerves.
Well, the -- oh, the things with Johnny Hodges, the ballads, with Otto Hardwick, they're soothing. But when Ellington would start writing all those clashes, then
I'd have a breakdown and go right back in the operating room, I guess. I don't know.
